content.text:
Waived fees no longer count as owed, so a member whose fees were waived can check out again and their account summary no longer shows the waived amount. All 61 tests pass, including the new one.

The cause was in `lib/fees/balance.js`. `outstandingBalance` only skipped fees that were `paid`, so a waived fee, which has `waivedReason` set, was still summed. The checkout refusal (`lib/members/eligibility.js`) and the account summary (`lib/server/routes/members.js`) both read that function. The fix is one filter change in `outstandingBalance`, which now skips fees that are paid or waived.

I added a test, "a waived fee is not owed", in `test/fees.test.js`. It waives one of two fees and checks that only the other still counts.

I left `payFee` alone, so a fee that was already waived can still be marked as paid. The balance ignores it either way. Say if you want that refused.
